description: highly detailed HD pixel art with painterly shading and layered depth, a cinematic wide establishing shot for a trucking tycoon game: Pittsburgh at the three rivers with yellow bridges, the PPG Place glass castle and the incline, its real skyline rising in the middle distance with every landmark clearly recognisable, seen from above a busy interstate in the foreground where American long-nose conventional semi tractors with long hoods, chrome grilles and sleeper cabs pull white trailers, never a flat-faced European cab-over truck, a blank green overhead highway sign, the city's own surroundings and water or hills beyond, a grey overcast rainy afternoon, low cloud brushing the tower tops, rain streaking down, wet roads reflecting headlights and brake lights, puddles on the shoulders, muted blue-grey colours with warm lit windows, no text, lettering, words, labels or logos anywhere
